patterns.observation: Vasanth compared the use of JNAI in coding to the era of pre-calculators, implying an inevitable change in practice.

proposed_adaptation.action: Use an analogy comparing past transitions to new technological integrations to emphasize their inevitability.
proposed_adaptation.limits: Avoid assuming uniform acceptance of technology; analogy might not apply to all individuals.
proposed_adaptation.when: Discussing technology adoption in a training context.

patterns.qualification: One example supports an isolated observation, not a recurring habit.
